measurement: Actual application Demo enrichment storage, 2048 synthetic targets, one connection run and three manual power runs
sourceScopeNote: These are the exact measured ecca1d2 application assemblies. Later HTTP response-serialization changes and final Windows artifacts are separate evidence, not a remeasurement of this source.

environment.executionPath: Actual application HTTP manual collection request -> shared coordinator -> enrichment runner -> SQLite
environment.configuredIntervalSource: Measurement operator configuration; power run DTOs independently record Manual trigger.

redactions.reason: Absolute local data directory omitted; all numeric snapshot values retained.

publication.omittedPrivateFields: Power receipt queue IDs, local sample paths and unrelated health are not exported; complete run DTOs and selected AP clocks are retained. Snapshot provider-bridge metadata has no local path and is retained. No DB raw values or source observation payloads are included.

method.sqlConsistency: Each snapshot uses sqlite3 mode=ro and one BEGIN read transaction; a read-only provider bridge is used when recorded in that snapshot.
method.filesystemConsistency: Main/WAL/SHM and backup stat samples are separate from the SQL transaction, not an atomic filesystem snapshot.
method.schemaVersionMeaning: Raw snapshots.schemaVersion is PRAGMA user_version (observed 6 in all five snapshots).
method.pageAccounting: dbstat pageBytes includes allocated pages; unusedBytes is free space inside those same pages, not extra bytes and not freelist bytes.
method.baseline: AP run 5 after configuration change. The successful initial measurement followed an earlier failed attempt and AP run 4 -> 5; it is not the failed-attempt instant or an empty database.
method.rawValuePolicy: Aggregate counts, times, sizes and schema object names only; no observation contents exported.

readOnlyProviderBridge.filesystemNote: WAL/SHM sizes include read-provider sidecar initialization; main file mtime/size/SHA256 unchanged

measurementContext.note: Successful retry after enrichment-settings change and AP run 5; the original failed attempt preceded this snapshot. No connection or power collection had yet run.

observedPowerRuns.durationDefinition: FinalizedAtUtc minus StartedAtUtc; includes runner acquisition/finalization, not a sampling interval or an HTTP throughput benchmark.

projection.classification: Arithmetic extrapolation only; not observed 30-day storage, not a capacity or SLA guarantee.
projection.extrapolationFormula: min/max of the three observed database growth increments * 2880; excludes the initial AP/connection baseline and backup storage.
assumptions: All 2048 active targets provide all six distinct metric meanings on each hypothetical run, with a new raw sample identity per metric and run.
Measured: three runs with a configured 60-minute interval and manual requests. The 15-minute interval and 30 days are hypothetical projection inputs.
The first power run also allocates current/cache/state records. Multiplying its increment repeats startup cost; the three-point range is not a fitted steady-state growth model.
The range includes all DB growth between each pair of power snapshots, not only power_samples table payload.
No 30-day retention cycle, sustained workload, long-term DB shrink, disk-size requirement or runtime SLA was measured.
Retention removes raw power_samples older than 30 days by read_at_utc. Identity/history, permanent incident copies, AP future writes and other retained metadata need not shrink with the raw table.
Actual file growth depends on page reuse, indexes, future changes and journal/checkpoint behavior.
Backup measurements are only the two existing directory files totaling 692658 bytes, not seven full backups of the final database. Budget production backups and maintenance headroom separately.
Live enrichment adapters remain unimplemented, unverified and disabled; this synthetic Demo run establishes no live metric availability or Windows/manual equipment result.
